title: Flux Pro v1.1
description: FLUX1.1 [pro] is an enhanced version of FLUX.1 [pro], improved image generation capabilities, delivering superior composition, detail, and artistic fidelity compared to its predecessor.

inputs.name: prompt
inputs.tooltip: The prompt to generate an image from.

inputs.name: image_size
inputs.tooltip: The size of the generated image. 'custom' uses the width and height below.

inputs.name: seed
inputs.tooltip: The same seed and the same prompt given to the same version of the model will output the same image every time. -1 leaves it to the model.

inputs.name: num_images
inputs.tooltip: The number of images to generate.

inputs.name: output_format
inputs.tooltip: The format of the generated image.

inputs.name: safety_tolerance
inputs.tooltip: The safety tolerance level for the generated image. 1 being the most strict and 5 being the most permissive.

inputs.name: enhance_prompt
inputs.tooltip: Whether to enhance the prompt for better results.

omitted.why: yes/no sync_mode returns the file inline and drops it from fal's request history - always left off
